about.title: About · MemoryDuel Knowledge Battle
about.meta_desc: MemoryDuel - A knowledge battle platform with multi-category question banks. 1v1 and multiplayer online knowledge duels.
about.what_desc: MemoryDuel is a knowledge battle platform with instant duels across multiple categories. No ads, no tracking, supports 1v1/multiplayer online battles, AI training, and personal rank system. Click to play, no registration required.
about.mode_duel_desc: 1v1 instant duel with trivia questions (science, tech, art, history, lifestyle, etc.). Winner is determined by speed and accuracy.
about.mode_train_desc: Card matching, number flash memory, multiple difficulty levels. Personal bests saved locally.
about.mode_ai_desc: Battle against AI bots, simulating real duel rhythm.
about.feature_multilang_desc: Questions in Chinese, English, Japanese, German, French, Spanish. Players from around the world compete together.
about.feature_realtime_desc: Real-time matching, instant start, no waiting.
about.feature_rank_desc: Bronze to Champion ranking system. Climb the leaderboard with winning streaks.
about.feature_ai_desc: Start a game anytime without waiting for a real opponent.
about.feature_noad_desc: Zero interruptions, no user behavior tracking.
about.feature_crossdev_desc: Play on phone, tablet, or computer. Anytime, anywhere.
about.why_desc: Research shows active recall is the most effective memory consolidation method. Knowledge battles use timed Q&A + competitive pressure to activate active recall, providing 3-5x better retention than passive reading.
about.why_benefits_intro: 10 minutes of daily battles across trivia, science, art, history and more. Long-term benefits include:
about.benefit_1: Broaden knowledge and keep your brain active
about.benefit_2: Improve quick reaction and decision-making skills
about.benefit_3: Meet knowledge enthusiasts from around the world
about.tech_desc: Pure frontend HTML5 + CSS3 + JavaScript. Data stored in browser localStorage. Real-time duel sync provided by Cloudflare Worker WebSocket service. No login required, open and play.
about.feedback_desc: For game suggestions, feature feedback, or suspected issues, contact mathduel@foxmail.com. We take every piece of feedback seriously.
about.cta_title: Ready to give it a try?
about.cta_desc: Flip the first card and start your memory training.

mm_privacy_7: MemoryDuel follows a privacy-first principle and collects as little data as possible:
mm_privacy_8: Local storage: game records, high scores, and training records are saved in your browser's localStorage and never leave your device.
mm_privacy_9: Anonymous battle data: if you play online battles, we generate a random UUID to identify your account for leaderboards and stats. This UUID is not linked to any personal identity.
mm_privacy_10: Anonymous stats: we may use privacy-friendly analytics (e.g. Plausible) to collect aggregate visits, with no IP addresses or personal identity.
mm_privacy_12: We don't collect names, emails, phone numbers, or other personal identity (unless you contact us by email).
mm_privacy_13: We don't read your contacts or address book.
mm_privacy_14: We don't use third-party ads or behavioral tracking.
mm_privacy_15: We don't use Google Analytics or other tracking analytics.
mm_privacy_17: We may use one cookie (pid) to store an anonymous account ID for recognizing the same user on the leaderboard. You can clear browser cookies anytime.
mm_privacy_19: Local training records stay in your browser and are deleted when you clear browser data. Battle leaderboard data is served by Cloudflare edge storage; aggregate stats are periodically purged.
mm_privacy_21: We may use these third-party services:
mm_privacy_22: Plausible Analytics: a privacy-friendly analytics tool (no cookies, GDPR-compliant). See Plausible's data policy.
mm_privacy_23: Cloudflare: web hosting and CDN. See Cloudflare's privacy policy.
mm_privacy_25: This site is for all ages. Since we collect no personal identity, COPPA or GDPR-K children's data issues don't apply.
mm_privacy_27: We collect very little data, mostly on your local device. You can:
mm_privacy_28: Clear browser localStorage anytime to delete local records
mm_privacy_30: Block Plausible Analytics (install an extension like uBlock Origin)
mm_privacy_32: We won't sell, rent, or share user data with third parties except where legally required.
mm_privacy_34: We may update this policy from time to time. Major changes will be announced on the homepage.
mm_privacy_36: For privacy questions, contact mathduel@foxmail.com with [Privacy] in the subject.
